# Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.1-rc.7

Coordinated development candidate for CPUL 1.0.0-rc.11 and Standalone TBT 1.0.0-rc.4. HMG-API >=1.1.0-rc.10. Intended K5 validation target: DL322 USA 260507. Vehicle validation pending; this is not a claim that all new functionality works on the car.

## Shared vehicle and theme identity
- Public CarPlayIdentification API v3 with independent vehicle/theme registration, owner isolation and native construction/readiness diagnostics.
- Explicit opt-in gasoline Kia K5 identity without fabricated EV connector fields; stock identity default remains unchanged.
- Theme identity registration preserves full asset ID, version and SDK tuple from the companion; early StartSession preparation and validation with stock fallback on unavailable prerequisites.
- Native generation-scoped construction and dispatch evidence, bounded sizing checks, failure withdrawal, reconfiguration and resume recovery. Reported advertisement is native builder evidence, not phone acceptance or asset installation.

## Logging and USB diagnostics
- Persistent session-end WCP-LOGS exports, bounded session journals and native diagnostic collection, with extended collection opt-in.
- Verified USB export, mount identity checks, interrupted-copy recovery, checksum manifests, retention and categorized diagnostic events.
- Preserve existing wireless projection and integrated TBT behavior; integrated TBT stays off by default, and must be off when using Standalone TBT.

## Experimental FileTransfer groundwork (inactive)
- Research into CarPlayUpdateData, type-130 RemoteControl and consistent feature/INFO negotiation.
- Offline-tested bounded OPACK and decoded-message validation, SHA-256 quarantine capture, cancellation, metadata preservation and reopening, admission limits.
- No live FileTransfer receiver, new capability advertisement, synthetic acknowledgements, archive installation, USB theme export or version update. Actual client UUID, socket/framing/encryption and SETUP/INFO contract still unresolved. CPUL Stage 1 passive discovery is separate; Stage 2 remains unauthorized.

## Compatibility and release checks
- Preserve package identity and existing author key. RC10 SDK source-floor validation, native identity tests, session logging and export regression, experimental quarantine tests and CPUL recipe collision guard.
- Full development regression suite required by signed release workflow.
- Use CPUL's final coordinated compatible source/release pins and its Stage 1 diagnostic setting for targeted testing. WCP bridge enabled; opt in to K5 gasoline identity on the supported gasoline K5; WCP integrated TBT disabled when STBT installed.
- Waze guidance, phone-managed theme selector/wallpaper, actual identity negotiation and vehicle USB recovery remain on-car acceptance items. No promise of new Waze support.

No vehicle validation has been performed for this candidate; final source audit, CI and user publication authorization required before release.
